purpose: Reviewed snapshot of the fixed physical and task constants. Source of truth is the code; tests/test_fixed_constants.py fails when they differ. A change requires a protocol erratum (experiments/protocols/experimental_protocol_v1.md, errata policy).

patient_independence.task_contract.py: Task definition (velocities 6/12 mm/s, decision period 0.1 s, success window EPS = V_MAX*dt, dwell, lumen tolerance 1.5 mm, catastrophic-velocity and root-motion limits): properties of the insertion task and the instrument, not of any anatomy.
patient_independence.teacher/privileged_teacher.py: Action levels and the CRUISE margin (two CRUISE decisions of lag): functions of the three velocities and the decision period only.
patient_independence.physics/engine.py: Rod model (7 bodies of 30 mm, 3 mm capsule radius), solver iterations, stiffnesses, contact materials, time stepping: the catheter and the numerical scheme, validated once and applied unchanged to every patient.
patient_independence.physics/lumen_sdf.py: Lumen contact parameters (mesh voxel, projection target phi = -capsule radius, SDF query radius, axis samples): contact model constants, independent of anatomy.
patient_independence.physics/patient_episode.py: Settle frames, pre-deployed bodies, frames per decision: episode protocol constants.
patient_independence.anatomy/access_geometry.py: Spur length, descriptor window (73.5 mm rod + 100 mm travel), capsule radius, zone offset: measurement conventions fixed before the multi-patient analysis (calibrated on the reference patient and applied unchanged).
patient_independence.anatomy/episode_config.py: Start-condition rule (60-100 mm feed range, 73.5 mm rod behind the tip), zone offsets and the timeout formula: protocol definitions.
